testCases.title: Verify Sorting Dropdown Visibility
steps: Navigate to the product overview page.
expectedResults: The sorting dropdown is displayed on the product overview page.

testCases.title: Verify Sorting Dropdown Options
steps: Navigate to the product overview page.
expectedResults: The sorting dropdown includes the options: Name (A - Z), Name (Z - A), Price (High - Low), Price (Low - High).

testCases.title: Verify Product Sorting Functionality
steps: Navigate to the product overview page.
Select an option from the sorting dropdown.
expectedResults: The product grid reloads with products ordered according to the selected sort.
